title: AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'strip' on user profile update
description: Mobile users who leave the optional phone number blank encounter a 500 error when saving their profile settings. The backend fails when calling strip() on a None value.
error_log:
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File 'app/services/user_service.py', line 22, in update_user_profile
    user['phone'] = updates['phone'].strip()
AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'strip'
recent_changes: Commit e19a22: Added whitespace trimming on user contact inputs
expected_behavior: Should check if phone is a non-empty string before calling strip()
actual_behavior: Crashes with AttributeError when phone is None
